independent_schema.inferred_unit: molar, consistent with the source values and DeepRSMA preprocessing

source_method.R_SIM_database_scope: The database contains Ka, Kd, Ki, IC50, and EC50 records.
source_method.RSAPred_model_subset: Only Kd-quantified entries were retained; all Kd values were converted to molar before -log10 transformation.
source_method.DeepRSMA_statement: The processed 1,439-pair benchmark uses pKd as negative log10 dissociation constant.

auditable_conclusion: The local 1,439-pair benchmark is a Kd-derived pKd task according to the source methods, but its distributed CSV no longer contains per-entry raw Kd, unit, assay method, or citation fields. Therefore formula/range checks are possible, whereas per-entry assay and unit re-auditing is not.
